source.beginning_middle_ending_evidence: Read the whole consolidated statement of profit and loss to the auditor signature block, and notes 21-30 in full
source.limitations: Topic-built part (no single source). Data frozen at FY2026. Schedule III / Ind AS 1 text not read (MCA 403); two claims marked Mostly supported. Aggregators were never used for figures.

inventory.item: A P&L subtracts costs from revenue in a fixed order down to profit
Revenue from operations = main-business sales (TCPL note 21: goods, services, other operating revenue)
Revenue = volume x price (100 crore cups x Rs 5)
Cost of materials consumed
Employee benefits expense
Other expenses (rent, ads, power, freight)
Schedule III layout lists costs by nature; purchases of stock-in-trade and changes in inventories (TCPL 7,788.16 + 4,108.23 - 40.75)
Gross profit is not a reported line
EBITDA is not an Ind AS line; everyone computes it; definitions differ
EBITDA reached from the top and from the bottom (PBT 67 + 10 + 12 - 4 = 85)
Depreciation vs amortisation; spreading a purchase (120 over 10 years = 12)
EBIT = EBITDA - D&A
Other income (interest on cash, not from the business)
Finance costs (interest on borrowings)
Exceptional items: one-offs on their own line; can distort year-on-year change
Ind AS has no extraordinary line; exceptional loosely defined
Profit before tax, tax (current + deferred)
Profit after tax; owners of parent vs non-controlling interests
EPS teaser: PAT / 10 crore shares = Rs 5 (Part 7 teaches it)
Margins: mention only (Part 8)
Share of profit/loss of associates and JVs (TCPL line Ramu lacks)
TCPL FY2026 consolidated figures mapped onto the waterfall
Drivable waterfall lab
Three questions for any P&L
Hand-off to Part 4, The balance sheet
